columns.dc:description: Name of the organisation associated with the contract record.
A Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) which identifies the organisation.
Date of the end of the financial quarter to which the data relates, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Unique identifier used to distinguish the contract record.
Name of the contract record in Atamis.
Type of agreement, such as Goods, Works or Services.
Council department responsible for the contract.
Council directorate responsible for the contract.
Short summary of the contract's purpose and scope.
Common Procurement Vocabulary describing the nature of the goods, services, or works.
Date the contract begins, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Current confirmed end date of the contract, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Calculated latest end date if all available extensions are used, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Original approved value of the contract before modifications in GBP.
Current total contract value including approved modifications in GBP.
Name of the supplier awarded or delivering the contract.
Indicates whether the supplier is a Small and Medium-sized Enterprise organisation.
Indicates whether the supplier is a Voluntary, Community, Faith or Social Enterprise organisation.
STAR officer responsible for managing or overseeing the record.
STAR Category Manager responsible for the contract category.
STAR procurement category assigned to the contract.
Procurement category used to classify the contract.
Procurement route or procedure used to award the contract.
Atamis reference or Salesforce ID of the related parent contract or framework.
Current status of the contract record in Atamis.
End date of the original contract term before extensions, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Collaboration or partner group associated with the procurement.
Indicates whether contract is recurring or a one-off purchase.
Supplier size classification recorded in Atamis.
